visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with white stylized text centered on a black background, fading in and out. (2) Transition to an indoor stage with a dark purple background and 'DEATH STRANDING' logos. Three men stand side by side; Hideo Kojima on the right in a black suit and glasses, a man in the center wearing a bright red coat and a black wide-brimmed hat, and another man on the left in a black jacket. (3) Close-up of Hideo Kojima sitting in a black chair, looking pensively toward the camera. (4) Scene shifts to an interview setting. Two men stand in front of a white wall with 'TAIPEI DEATH STRANDING 2' branding. The man on the left wears a white and denim split-pattern shirt, while the man on the right is the same man in the red coat and black hat. They gesture with their hands while talking. (5) Inset game footage appears showing a 3D animated character resembling the man in the red coat, wearing a purple jacket and blue hat, speaking in a digital environment. (6) Return to the interview scene. The interviewer (white/denim shirt) smiles and bows slightly while the director (red coat) laughs and makes hand signs. (7) Split-screen view with the interview on top and a scene from a horror film on the bottom, showing a woman with her hands together in prayer. (8) Photo montage follows, including the interviewer posing with Kojima, and a final group shot where five men stand in a row against the event backdrop, waving their hands toward the camera.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents an interaction between a popular content creator and film director Kevin Ko at a 'Death Stranding 2' promotional event. It highlights Ko's cameo in the game, discusses his work on the horror film 'Incantation', and builds excitement for Hideo Kojima's upcoming project through personal anecdotes and humorous interview clips.
